_comment: Maps a customization's upstream TARGET file -> the PR to diegosouzapw/OmniRoute that would upstream it. When a PR MERGES, its fix arrives via the next upstream release; on `node nexa/update.mjs` that patch becomes redundant (apply --check flags it) and is deleted -> the overlay self-shrinks. Consumed by gen-manifest.mjs (populates each item's upstreamPR). Refresh with: gh pr list --repo diegosouzapw/OmniRoute --author developerjillur --state all --json number,state,title,files
